narrative: On the tables. The writing-tables open against a horse's flank, dust on the board, a hand keeping the leaf from the wind. On the tables. The same leaf, a second block of the same hand, the flank shifting the board. Nothing else is on it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the friar and the four beats, and closed the tables.

entities.name: Romeo and Juliet
